description: Clouding of the eye's natural lens that reduces visual clarity and light transmission.
treatment_goal: Restore useful vision and improve quality of life.
curative_treatment_available: Surgery can effectively treat visually significant cataract.

description: A group of diseases causing progressive optic nerve damage, often associated with elevated intraocular pressure, leading to irreversible vision loss.
treatment_goal: Preserve remaining vision by controlling intraocular pressure.
curative_treatment_available: No cure exists; treatment aims to slow progression and preserve vision.

description: Microvascular complication of diabetes causing damage to retinal blood vessels, potentially leading to vision loss.
common_symptoms: dark or empty areas in vision
management: strict glycemic, blood pressure, and lipid control
treatment_goal: Prevent progression and preserve vision through early detection and control.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; treatment manages complications and slows progression.

description: Progressive degeneration of the macula, the central part of the retina, leading to loss of central vision in older adults.
treatment_goal: Slow progression and preserve central vision; treat neovascular complications.
curative_treatment_available: No cure for dry AMD; wet AMD is treatable but not curable.

description: A refractive error where distant objects appear blurry because the eye focuses images in front of the retina.
treatment_goal: Correct refractive error and provide clear distance vision.
curative_treatment_available: Refractive surgery can permanently correct myopia in suitable candidates.

description: A refractive error where near objects appear blurry because the eye focuses images behind the retina.
risk_factors: short axial length of the eye
treatment_goal: Correct refractive error and relieve symptoms of eye strain.
curative_treatment_available: Refractive surgery can permanently correct hyperopia in suitable candidates.

description: A refractive error caused by an irregularly shaped cornea or lens, resulting in blurred vision at all distances.
common_symptoms: blurred or distorted vision at all distances
treatment_goal: Correct the irregular curvature and provide clear vision at all distances.
curative_treatment_available: Refractive surgery can permanently correct astigmatism in suitable candidates.

description: An age-related loss of the eye's ability to focus on near objects due to decreased lens elasticity, typically beginning after age 40.
common_symptoms: holding reading material at arm's length
treatment_goal: Restore comfortable near vision for daily activities.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; it is a natural aging process managed with optical correction.

description: A multifactorial disease of the tears and ocular surface resulting in discomfort, visual disturbance, and tear film instability.
management: artificial tears and lubricating eye drops
treatment_goal: Improve tear film stability, reduce symptoms, and protect the ocular surface.
curative_treatment_available: No permanent cure; management focuses on symptom control and underlying causes.

description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva caused by infection, allergy, or irritants, commonly known as pink eye.
common_symptoms: redness in the white of the eye
diagnosis: conjunctival swab for culture (severe or recurrent cases)
management: viral: supportive care and cold compresses
bacterial: antibiotic eye drops or ointment
allergic: antihistamine or mast cell stabilizer drops
treatment_goal: Relieve symptoms, treat underlying cause, and prevent spread (infectious cases).
curative_treatment_available: Most cases resolve with appropriate treatment; viral cases are self-limiting.

description: Chronic inflammation of the eyelid margins, often involving the meibomian glands and lash follicles.
common_symptoms: crusting or flaking at the lash base
management: lid hygiene with diluted baby shampoo or commercial cleansers
treatment_goal: Control inflammation, improve meibomian gland function, and relieve symptoms.
curative_treatment_available: No permanent cure; requires ongoing management.

description: Separation of the neurosensory retina from the underlying retinal pigment epithelium, causing vision loss if not treated promptly.
common_symptoms: shadow or curtain over visual field
treatment_goal: Reattach the retina promptly to preserve vision.
curative_treatment_available: Surgical repair can successfully reattach the retina if performed promptly.

description: Progressive thinning and bulging of the cornea into a cone shape, causing distorted vision.
common_symptoms: increased sensitivity to light and glare
treatment_goal: Halt progression and improve visual acuity with optical or surgical correction.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; cross-linking can halt progression, and transplantation restores vision in advanced cases.

description: Reduced vision in one or both eyes due to abnormal visual development during childhood, commonly known as lazy eye.
diagnosis: complete eye examination to rule out structural causes
management: atropine penalization of the stronger eye
treatment of underlying cause (e.g., cataract removal)
treatment_goal: Improve visual acuity in the affected eye during the critical period of visual development.
curative_treatment_available: Vision can be significantly improved if treated early in childhood.

description: Misalignment of the eyes where they do not look in the same direction at the same time.
common_symptoms: eyes that appear crossed or turned
treatment_goal: Restore proper eye alignment and improve binocular vision.
curative_treatment_available: Surgery and other treatments can successfully align the eyes.

description: Inherited or acquired condition causing difficulty distinguishing certain colors, most commonly red and green.
common_symptoms: difficulty distinguishing red and green (most common)
difficulty distinguishing blue and yellow (less common)
rarely, complete inability to see color
management: color-corrective glasses or contact lenses (limited benefit)
treatment_goal: Assist with daily color discrimination; no treatment can restore normal color vision.
curative_treatment_available: No cure for inherited color vision deficiency.

description: Swelling or thickening of the macula due to fluid accumulation, leading to distorted or blurred central vision.
treatment_goal: Reduce macular fluid and improve or stabilize central vision.
curative_treatment_available: Treatable but often requires ongoing management; outcomes depend on underlying cause.

description: A small break in the macula causing blurred and distorted central vision, often related to vitreous traction.
common_symptoms: dark spot in the center of vision
management: pars plana vitrectomy with internal limiting membrane peeling
treatment_goal: Close the macular hole and restore central vision.
curative_treatment_available: Vitrectomy surgery can successfully close the hole and improve vision in most cases.

description: Formation of scar tissue on the macula's surface (epiretinal membrane), causing visual distortion.
common_symptoms: mildly blurred or distorted central vision
management: pars plana vitrectomy with membrane peeling (significant visual impairment)
treatment_goal: Remove the epiretinal membrane and improve visual acuity.
curative_treatment_available: Surgery can successfully remove the membrane and improve vision.

description: Separation of the vitreous gel from the retinal surface, a common age-related condition.
common_symptoms: flashes of light in peripheral vision
management: urgent evaluation to rule out retinal tear or detachment
scleral buckling or vitrectomy if retinal complications occur
treatment_goal: Monitor for complications; no treatment needed for uncomplicated cases.
curative_treatment_available: Usually resolves on its own; treatment only if retinal complications develop.

description: Blockage of the central retinal vein causing retinal hemorrhage, edema, and vision loss.
treatment_goal: Reduce macular edema and neovascular complications; manage systemic risk factors.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; treatment aims to stabilize vision and prevent complications.

description: Inflammation of the uveal tract (iris, ciliary body, choroid) that can affect vision and may be associated with systemic diseases.
diagnosis: laboratory tests and imaging for systemic associations
treatment_goal: Control inflammation, relieve pain, and prevent vision-threatening complications.
curative_treatment_available: Treatable and often controllable; may require long-term management.

description: A group of inherited retinal dystrophies causing progressive degeneration of photoreceptors, leading to night blindness and peripheral vision loss.
common_symptoms: progressive loss of peripheral vision (tunnel vision)
eventual loss of central vision in advanced cases
risk_factors: genetic mutations (autosomal dominant, recessive, or X-linked)
treatment_goal: Slow progression where possible and optimize remaining vision.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; gene therapy available for specific genetic subtypes.

description: Abnormal blood vessel development in the retina of premature infants, potentially leading to retinal detachment and blindness.
treatment_goal: Prevent progression to retinal detachment and preserve vision.
curative_treatment_available: Early treatment can prevent blindness; not all cases require intervention.

description: Malignant tumor of the retina, the most common primary intraocular malignancy in children.
management: focal laser therapy or cryotherapy (small tumors)
treatment_goal: Save the child's life, preserve the eye when possible, and maximize vision.
curative_treatment_available: Highly curable when detected early; survival rates exceed 95% in developed countries.

description: Autoimmune inflammatory disorder affecting the orbit and extraocular muscles, commonly associated with hyperthyroidism.
risk_factors: Graves' disease or other thyroid dysfunction
diagnosis: clinical examination of orbit and eyelids
treatment_goal: Control inflammation, protect the cornea, and preserve optic nerve function.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; treatment manages symptoms and prevents vision loss.

description: A congenital defect in ocular tissue caused by incomplete closure of the optic fissure during embryonic development.
common_symptoms: variable visual impairment depending on location and size
management: monitoring for associated complications (retinal detachment, cataract)
treatment_goal: Optimize vision and monitor for associated complications.
curative_treatment_available: No cure for the structural defect; management focuses on visual rehabilitation.

description: Rare congenital conditions where the eye fails to develop (anophthalmia) or is abnormally small (microphthalmia).
management: ocular prosthetics for cosmetic and orbital development
treatment_goal: Promote normal facial and orbital development and provide visual rehabilitation.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; management is supportive and rehabilitative.

description: A focal dystonia characterized by involuntary, sustained, and forceful closure of the eyelids.
diagnosis: neurological evaluation to rule out secondary causes
treatment_goal: Reduce involuntary eyelid closure and improve functional vision.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; botulinum toxin provides temporary relief and requires repeated injections.

description: A common binocular vision disorder where the eyes have difficulty working together when focusing on near objects.
common_symptoms: words moving or floating on the page
treatment_goal: Improve convergence ability and eliminate symptoms during near work.
curative_treatment_available: Vision therapy and exercises can effectively treat convergence insufficiency.

description: An open sore on the cornea caused by infection, trauma, or underlying disease, posing a risk of vision loss.
diagnosis: corneal scraping for culture and sensitivity
treatment_goal: Eliminate infection, promote healing, and prevent corneal perforation or scarring.
curative_treatment_available: Most cases resolve with prompt antimicrobial treatment; severe cases may require surgery.

description: A benign, wing-shaped growth of conjunctival tissue onto the cornea, often related to UV exposure.
common_symptoms: blurred vision if encroaching on the visual axis
management: surgical excision with conjunctival autograft (progressive or visually significant)
treatment_goal: Relieve symptoms and remove growth if visually significant or cosmetically concerning.
curative_treatment_available: Surgical excision with grafting has low recurrence rates.

description: Inflammation of the optic nerve causing acute vision loss, often associated with demyelinating diseases.
common_symptoms: acute vision loss in one eye
diagnosis: visual acuity and color vision testing
optical coherence tomography (OCT) of retinal nerve fiber layer
treatment_goal: Accelerate visual recovery and manage underlying demyelinating disease.
curative_treatment_available: Most patients recover significant vision; treatment accelerates recovery but does not prevent recurrence.

description: A break in the retinal tissue that can lead to retinal detachment if fluid passes through it.
management: prompt treatment to prevent retinal detachment
treatment_goal: Seal the tear to prevent progression to retinal detachment.
curative_treatment_available: Laser or cryotherapy can effectively seal the tear and prevent detachment.

description: A chorioretinal condition caused by presumed ocular involvement with Histoplasma capsulatum, characterized by peripheral atrophic scars and macular choroidal neovascularization.
risk_factors: exposure to Histoplasma capsulatum (Ohio and Mississippi River valleys)
treatment_goal: Treat choroidal neovascularization and preserve central vision.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; treatment manages neovascular complications.

description: The most common inherited macular dystrophy, causing progressive central vision loss due to lipofuscin accumulation in retinal pigment epithelium cells.
common_symptoms: difficulty with reading and recognizing faces
management: clinical trials for gene therapy and stem cell therapy
treatment_goal: Optimize remaining vision and support adaptation to visual impairment.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; management is supportive.

description: A genetic condition characterized by combined hearing loss and progressive vision loss due to retinitis pigmentosa.
risk_factors: mutations in USH1, USH2, or USH3 genes
treatment_goal: Optimize hearing and vision function; support communication and independence.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; management focuses on sensory rehabilitation and support.

description: A rare inherited retinal dystrophy characterized by crystalline deposits in the retina and choroidal atrophy, leading to progressive vision loss.
risk_factors: higher prevalence in East Asian populations
treatment_goal: Optimize remaining vision and provide supportive care.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; management is supportive.

description: A rare, chronic systemic vasculitis that can cause recurrent, severe intraocular inflammation (uveitis) and vision-threatening complications.
risk_factors: higher prevalence along the Silk Road (Middle East to East Asia)
diagnosis: clinical criteria (recurrent oral ulcers plus two of: genital ulcers, eye lesions, skin lesions, pathergy test)
treatment_goal: Control inflammation, prevent recurrences, and preserve vision.
curative_treatment_available: No cure; requires long-term immunosuppressive management.

description: Elevated intracranial pressure without an identifiable cause, often causing papilledema and vision-threatening complications.
common_symptoms: diplopia (double vision from sixth nerve palsy)
risk_factors: certain medications (tetracyclines, isotretinoin, excess vitamin A)
diagnosis: MRI/MRV of brain (to exclude secondary causes)
lumbar puncture (elevated opening pressure, normal CSF analysis)
treatment_goal: Preserve vision and reduce intracranial pressure and associated symptoms.
curative_treatment_available: Often resolves with weight loss; may require ongoing management.
